name: Do I need to remove old tiles before installing new ones?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to remove old tiles before installing new ones?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, it is recommended to remove old tiles before installing new ones. This ensures a flat, stable, and clean surface for the new installation, which is crucial for the longevity and appearance of your new tiling. While it might be possible to tile over existing surfaces in specific situations, it often leads to an uneven finish or adhesion issues. Our team will assess your current surface and advise on the best approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Removing old tiles is usually recommended to ensure a stable and even surface for new tile installation.
